processAndSecurity.cleanup: Only directly spawned child process groups are signaled. Preconfigured healthy services are reused and remain alive after LocalStack.stop(). Startup failure and abort run the same idempotent cleanup path.
processAndSecurity.diagnostics: Per-process output is bounded to 8192 characters and redacts credentials, authorization values, and long secret-shaped hex. Errors retain safe service, exit, deadline, and port metadata only.
processAndSecurity.isolation: One validated offset moves validator, Photon, prover, and prover metrics. Occupied ports fail before spawning; unique temporary ledger, account, and Photon database paths are removed on stop.
processAndSecurity.prover: Readiness checks /health only. Startup does not request a circuit proof, preserving the server's lazy proving-key behavior.
processAndSecurity.secrets: Deterministic wallet seeds are copied into production key constructors and are never logged or attached to errors. Fixed fixture material remains private test input.
